guesses.reason: Classic black-and-tan saddle with a long, silky, rich golden-tan coat on the head and legs and a small, compact terrier build.
Somewhat longer body with short, sturdy legs and drop ears that hang lower and fuller than a typical Yorkie's upright ears.
Fuller, slightly broader face with heavy facial furnishings and floppy, well-feathered ears.

breed.appearance: A small, low-set dog with a long, silky, slightly wavy coat: rich golden-tan to russet on the head, ears, chest, and legs, with a darker black-and-grey saddle over the back and shoulders. Its ears are soft, heavily feathered drop ears framing a rounded face with dark brown almond eyes, a black button nose, and a short muzzle with long tan whiskery furnishings. It wears a teal nylon collar with silver rings and sits with feathery front paws planted forward.
breed.fun_fact: Yorkshire Terriers may be tiny, but they were originally bred as fearless ratters in English mills—big personality in a pocket-sized package!
